screens.title: Task Details (Interactive)
screens.prompt:
Recreate the Task Details screen ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_10}}) and add interactive prototype links:
1. Link the "Назад" (back) button in the top app bar to the Inbox screen ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_6}}).
2. Link the "Inbox" button in the bottom navigation to the Inbox screen ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_6}}).
3. Link the "Closed" button in the bottom navigation to the Closed Tasks screen ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_3}}).

Strictly preserve the existing design, Beltelecom brand identity (purple/cyan palette), Russian labels, and all content details. Ensure the bottom navigation island is styled correctly as shown in the original.

outputComponents.text:
I've updated the **Task Details** screen with interactive prototype links to complete your navigation flow:

- **Назад (Back)**: Now returns you to the **Inbox**.
- **Bottom Navigation**: 
    - Tapping **Inbox** leads to the **Inbox** screen.
    - Tapping **Closed** switches to the **Closed Tasks** screen.

I've carefully preserved the Beltelecom visual design, including the purple brand header, typography, and the floating navigation island at the bottom. You can now test these transitions directly in the preview.
